schedule: all 21 cases and eight budgets shuffled within each repetition; six arm permutations used twice per case/budget
execution: serial fresh processes, one query per process, no inference warmup
scope: loaded-query CPU including native hook and telemetry; cooperative deadlines
held_out_rule: frozen model; evaluation outcomes cannot alter model, features, policies or budgets
failures: retain every run; invalid execution separate from deadline/exhaustion; no replacement measurements
audit_rule: audit policy paths on evaluation cases before timing, with native one-step checks; audit timings are not comparison results
